messages:
kayla: Heads-up — docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987 is blocked. I changed the example for the new `exec_mode` config but runtime says behavior for "sync" vs "async" when `batching=false` is ambiguous. CI preview passed linkcheck but the runtime smoke tests fail with different tokenization. Need a runtime confirmation before we merge. cc @mike @sven

mike: looking. can you paste the minimal config you're documenting?

kayla: sure — snippet:
```
model:
  name: open-llama-7b
  exec_mode: auto
  batching: false
  fallback: true
```
Docs says `exec_mode: auto` -> "switch to sync when batching disabled". Is that guaranteed or an implementation detail?

sven: runtime: it's an implementation detail for now. `auto` prefers batching heuristics; when batching disabled we currently fall back to a sync path in the serving runtime, but that could change with upcoming kernel updates. Not safe to promise in docs.

kayla: ok — so we should change wording to "may run in sync mode when batching disabled" and add a note. also the SDK snippet needs to reflect the actual behavior for streaming responses.

olivia: for SDK snippet, prefer showing how to force `exec_mode: sync` explicitly:
```js
client.request({
  model: "open-llama-7b",
  exec_mode: "sync",
  stream: true
})
```

jess: can we get a quick sign-off? @mike can you confirm this week? merge hold until we update wording.

mike: confirmed — runtime won't guarantee `auto` -> `sync` forever. i'll open a small RFC if we want to lock behavior. until then update docs wording and add "experimental" note.

kayla: thanks. i'll push an amend with wording change + SDK snippet. anyone want to review the change? @jess @sven

sven: will review after lunch :ok_hand:

merge-bot: Merge hold applied by docs-protect (reason: runtime-behavior-clarification)

kayla: noted. will ping when amended :eyes:
